# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 20 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 20
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. It is therefore good that one who has learned the righteous ordinances of the Lord, as many as are written, should walk in them. For whoever does these things will be glorified in the kingdom of God; and whoever chooses the opposite will perish along with his works.
2. For this reason there is a resurrection; for this reason there is a retribution.
3. I beseech those who occupy positions of honor — if you have received any counsel of good will, to have among you those from whom you may be helped, take thought for this and strive all the more for it.
